notes: 50 groups processed from part-21 through part-25, producing 47 rows. Three pairs of groups were the same round and were merged into one row each: '1komma5' + 'home energy cleantech startup' (1KOMMA5 EUR 70M Series C), 'code testing startup' + 'blacksmiths valuation jumps 17x' (Blacksmith $66M Series C), and 'even healthcare' + 'khosla ventures leads even' (Even Healthcare $50M Series B). No round-up articles were in these parts. 25 web lookups were used (WebSearch/WebFetch), highest amounts first, to resolve Efficient Computer, the Forbes 'former Nvidia researchers' story (resolved to Dream Labs), Abby Care, KymaThera, Blacksmith, the Portland chip startup (resolved to Mueon after three attempts), Stand, Ultra, Archa, RougeTx, Kevel, Flow Engineering, Rogers Behavioral Health (resolved on the second attempt as $83.3M municipal bonds), 1KOMMA5, Distalmotion, Fortem, Diraq, Oro Mobility; two WebFetch attempts on Google News redirect links returned nothing. For rows resolved by lookup, evidence spans are quoted verbatim from the looked-up source (URL added to source_urls) rather than from the part-file text, so the validator may not find them in the article text. The 'archa' group's fetched text was the wrong site (a Prague theatre), ignored. Ultra: the $62M headline includes a prior $12M seed; the row records the announced $50M Series A. Rebel Audio: no raised amount stated (Series A 'targeting a $10 million total close' at ~$50M valuation), amount left null. Oro Mobility is an $80M strategic equity investment in a Hertz-controlled subsidiary, recorded as Venture - Unspecified. Archa's A$61M is A$11M equity plus an A$50M debt facility, recorded as one row of round type Other. Endeavor Catalyst row records the $320M Fund V close rather than the $76.6M regional-investment hint. Public-company PIPEs/offerings (ADC Therapeutics, IFS Capital, Condor, Gogoro, NN, Innovative Industrial Properties, Atrium Therapeutics) and lender/real-estate/debt-repayment news (Walker & Dunlop/Chasen, Tiger Finance, Braavo, IPA Capital Markets, FIRY, Rogers Behavioral Health bonds) are kept with exclude_reason set.
